survival.ui.title: Don't Follow the Voice
survival.ui.unofficial: An unofficial work of fiction set on the NTHU campus
survival.ui.name: Name (up to 12 characters)
survival.ui.name_input: After typing, click Enter campus or press Tab, then Enter.
survival.ui.replace: Starting a new expedition replaces the current run.
survival.ui.empty_journal: No observations recorded. Check the campus map and choose where to go.
survival.fixture.lawn: Read the note at Campus Green
survival.fixture.recording: Play the recording at the counter
survival.fixture.mimic: Respond to the cry around the corner
survival.intro.0.text: Thunder fades, but the gate is still shaking. You think it's an earthquake until the streetlights go dark one after another.
survival.intro.1.text: Water slaps against the shore. Fog crawls across the path. Something hits the ground.
survival.intro.2.text: A student kneels to help someone up. The person on the ground bites into his arm. The second scream cuts short.
survival.intro.3.text: The speakers crackle. “Gather at the west bank of Success Lake.” The line repeats, down to the same pause.
survival.intro.4.text: The rain eases. From the gate, you can still hear the announcement repeating deeper inside campus.
survival.read.lawn: The rain has blurred the arrows. One line is legible: “The corrected notice is posted in Education 115.”
survival.read.evacuation: 17:39 correction: west bank canceled. Reception moved to Xin Hall, 1F. A slip reads: “Broadcast records are at the first-floor library counter. Compare timestamps.”
survival.read.recording: The 17:12 file matches the announcement outside, including the static after “west bank.” The operator's note points to the area west of the entrance.
survival.read.playback: From the approach outside the library, you watch a figure wait for footsteps and press play. It waves strangers over while replaying the canceled announcement.
survival.read.dispatch: The microphone is still powered. Two assembly points are written beside it. Use the timestamps and evidence to choose what to broadcast.
survival.read.dispatch_wait: The microphone works, but you haven't verified the assembly point. Check the Education Building notice, library recording, and the activity outside the entrance.
survival.read.west: The west bank was the 17:12 instruction. The 17:39 correction canceled it. You take your hand off the transmit button.
survival.read.exhibit: No one is under the display tables. Two empty backpacks and a note saying “Left already” remain.
survival.read.exhibition: A passage runs through the low shelves. Wet footprints lead from the entrance across a fallen display board.
survival.read.books: Reserved books sit untouched on the shelves. Pickup slips still mark a few of them.
survival.read.lounge: Green chairs, red chairs, and stools sit around the white tables. Someone cleared the rain off the window counter to set down an umbrella.
survival.read.board: Several handwritten notes point to the common room. The last sheet is blank, waiting for a report.
survival.read.mimic: A calm voice comes from around the corner: “Could you help me? I'm right here.” It repeats with exactly the same inflection.
survival.read.test_voice: You ask which way they're facing. Instead of answering, the voice repeats “I'm right here,” with the same pause.
survival.read.student: I heard classmates running toward the exhibition room. Someone said to go to the lake, but I don't trust that announcement. Can I come with you?
survival.read.student_search: If there are bags under the display tables, look for a note. They would leave one before moving on.
survival.read.clerk: That announcement always glitches in the same place. I want to get out alive. For a bottle of water, I'll come with you or trade you a spare battery.
survival.read.stranger: I saw those boxes first. Give me the water if you want to travel together. If something chases us, I'll protect what I'm carrying first.
survival.read.ask_stranger: “The last person I traveled with?” He pulls the bag behind him. “When the crowd came, I didn't look back.”
survival.read.bitten: They cover the bite with one hand. Their fingers shake, and they can barely finish a sentence.
survival.read.joined: I can keep up. Check behind us before opening the door.
survival.choice.trust: Trust him with a bottle of water
survival.choice.test_voice: Ask a question they can't rehearse
survival.choice.west: Broadcast: gather at the west bank
survival.clue.storm.title: 17:42–17:47 · A storm
survival.clue.storm.text: The gate shook, streetlights went out, and low fog crossed the lake path.
survival.clue.evacuation.title: 17:39 · Correction in Education 115
survival.clue.evacuation.text: West bank canceled. The new assembly point is Xin Hall, 1F.
survival.clue.recording.title: 17:12 · Library desk recording
survival.clue.recording.text: The speakers are looping the older recording. A note points west of the entrance.
survival.clue.playback.title: Outside the entrance · Someone is replaying it
survival.clue.playback.text: A figure uses the old announcement to lure people closer. Xin Hall can broadcast the correction.
survival.clue.dispatch.title: Xin Hall · Correction sent
survival.clue.dispatch.text: West bank assembly canceled. Proceed to Xin Hall, 1F.
survival.goal.evacuation: Compare the evidence with the correction in Education 115.
survival.goal.recording: Compare broadcast timestamps at the first-floor library counter.
survival.goal.playback: Go west of the library entrance and watch the playback equipment.
survival.goal.dispatch: Choose the assembly point to announce from the Xin Hall common room.
survival.event.infected: Someone was bitten and is starting to shake.
survival.event.betrayal: Ting ran off with the water you gave him.
survival.event.empty_bat: Nothing in this slot. Consider where the bat should appear. Check the map.
survival.event.full: You don't need to replenish this yet.
survival.event.empty_battery: The flashlight is out of power.
survival.event.no_charge: You need a flashlight with less than 85% charge.
survival.event.used_bat: The swing can draw nearby infected.
survival.event.no_water: You have no water to give them.
survival.event.shared: You shared a bottle of water.
survival.event.team_full: You can travel with up to two companions.
survival.event.traded: You traded a bottle of water for a battery.
survival.event.traded_already: That was the last spare battery.
survival.ending.arrival: After the announcement, footsteps echo in the corridor.
survival.ending.title: The Last Report
survival.ending.text: “This is Xin Hall. Reply if you can hear us.” {name} lets go of the transmit button. A few seconds later, the door opens.
survival.ending.student: Yu Hsu holds the door for the people still coming in.
survival.ending.clerk: Yu Chen leans back into the microphone. “Two have arrived.”
survival.ending.stranger: Ting sets his bag by the door. This time, he stays.
survival.ending.solo: You made it here alone. Now someone is answering your call.
survival.death.title: This run is over
survival.death.bite: An infected attacker landed a bite.
survival.death.reset: The next run starts at the opening and North Gate. Your team, gear, and story reset, and the infected and supplies are reshuffled.
survival.clue.lawn.title: Campus Green · A rain-soaked sign
survival.clue.lawn.text: The corrected notice is in Education 115.
survival.clue.exhibit.title: Room 113 · Classmates left
survival.clue.exhibit.text: A note beside the empty bags reads “Left already.”
survival.read.student_update: They already got out. Thanks for checking. I can go with you.
